title: Scaled Dot-Product Attention
hint: scores = Q @ K^T / sqrt(d_k), then softmax(scores, dim=-1) @ V. Use torch.bmm for batched matmul.

description.text: Implement scaled dot-product attention: softmax(QK^T / sqrt(d_k)) V with batched tensors. This is the foundation of multi-head attention and LLM blocks; keep softmax numerically stable along the key sequence dimension.

constraints: Use PyTorch only unless task says otherwise.
